title: Advanced Helicopter Rescue School
description:
Aviators participating in the Coast Guard's Advanced Helicopter School, explain the importance of the school during breaks in training along the coasts of northern Oregon and southern Washington, Nov. 7, 2018.

The school is conducted by personnel from Coast Guard Aviation Training Center Mobile, but is hosted by Coast Guard Sector Columbia River.

U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 1st Class Levi Read.
keywords: Sector Columbia River, Advanced Helicopter Rescue School, Aviation Training Center Mobile, Coast Guard, USCG
